title: Roots of unity in a field are finite cyclic with the degree bound
statement: Let $E$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $r\geq1$ be an integer. The subgroup $\mu_r(E)=\{z\in E^\times:z^r=1\}$ of the multiplicative group of units of $E$ is finite and cyclic, and $|\mu_r(E)|\leq r$.
